title: rubus candicans var. fragrans
intro:
Rubus candicans var. fragrans, commonly known as the Fragrant Raspberry or Snowberry, is a deciduous shrub belonging to the Rosaceae family, characterized by its white, fragrant flowers and red, edible fruits.

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the prevention of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Rubus candicans var. fragrans are attributed to its ability to promote digestive health, reduce stress and anxiety, and support immune function. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
